content: Even if destiny decrees that a goal cannot be reached, the honest labor put into the effort yields its own certain reward.
author: Thiruvalluvar
explanation: Thiruvalluvar elevates unyielding human endeavor. Even when external circumstances thwart an immediate outcome, sincere effort transforms the character of the worker.
practicalInsight: Dedicate yourself wholeheartedly to your most challenging task today without obsessing over the outcome. Trust the dignity of your effort.
reflectionPrompt: Am I holding back effort out of fear that success is not guaranteed?
